gaps.sentence: Applications must be received ___ two weeks of the closing date.

gaps.sentence: Everything was left ___ the care of the neighbours.

gaps.sentence: The surgeons operated ___ the light of head-torches when the power failed.

gaps.sentence: ___ the exception of the organ, every instrument in the chapel is original.

gaps.explanation: 'of one's own initiative' = without being asked.

gaps.sentence: The bus was so crowded that we travelled ___ discomfort.
